# Protocol X

> Protocol X is a free, public-domain (CC0) practice for rating how a leisure session leaves you. You time a session, rate five readings from 0 to 10 (Vitality, Clarity, Give, Pull, Spill), compute one score, and review the week. It is a self-observation practice, not medical advice. It has no connection to any cryptocurrency, token or trading platform. Languages: English, Arabic.

Score = 0.30×VRI + 0.25×CEI + 0.15×CQI + 0.15×(10−ARI) + 0.15×(10−WII), with Give (CQI) allowed to be N/A and the other weights scaled up in proportion. Safety gate: if Pull (ARI) ≥ 7 or Spill (WII) ≥ 6, the score is capped at 3.9 and labelled Harmful. Bands: 8.0–10 Enhancing, 6.0–7.9 Acceptable, 4.0–5.9 Warning, below 4.0 Harmful.
